limitations: GSC Open File 5529 is generalized bedrock at approximately 1:35,000,000, far coarser than a 1.98 km AOI.
Fractions are from a bounded WMS point grid, not polygon area intersection.
Map units are evidence only; no abundance, aqueous-alteration inference or geology similarity is produced.
The WMS service is a USGS rendering of the GSC data; the Excel/attribute database and original GIS ZIP were not downloaded.
non_claims: No geology similarity or combined six-dimension score.
No global or exhaustive lithology coverage.

source.product: Generalized Geology of the World: Bedrock Domains and Major Faults in GIS Format
source.provider: Geological Survey of Canada / Natural Resources Canada; WMS by USGS Mineral Resources Program
